entities.name: Great Wall
entities.description: Huge hand-laid stone wall cutting off the Western Wastes of southwestern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Speculated the wall was built by magic and cast a teleport spell to move companions to its top.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Person whose trail Hazezon followed west from Palmyra.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: Ruler of the domain Johan headed to enter.

entities.description: Teleported to the top of the wall.

events.summary: In 3334 AR Hazezon comes to the wall following Johan's trail toward Shauku's domain, beseeches the desert spirits and teleports his companions to the top while he stays behind.
events.quote: Hazezon beseeched the desert spirits and cast a teleport spell
